Commands: /abyss exit.text: Teleports the executor their spawnpoint (or world spawn if their bed is in the abyss)

Commands: /abyss placestructure wreck.text: Places a random wreck infront of the executor Optionally you may provide another value to chose a specific varient default graveyard implosion porthole tube

Commands: /abyss vision.text: Grants the executor night vision and conduit power infinitely with no particles
